mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the months when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.2 percentage points over three months signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the months when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.0%, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the months when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the months during late-cycle expansions when HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the months when INDPRO is above 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in job growth (PAYEMS) below 0.1% per month over the past three months indicates weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the months when PAYEMS growth is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the months when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 198.0), the current level of CPIAUCSL (which is above 198.0) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to the risk of aggressive monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the months when CPIAUCSL > 198.0.
